segments.an7.78:1.1: [pari.327]“Sattahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
segments.an7.78:1.3: Āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ, dvepi jātiyo … pe … iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
segments.an7.78:1.8: Dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
segments.an7.78:1.9: Āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.an7.78:1.10: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotī”ti.
